entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Wow, this place really has[n]everything. You can eat, go on[n]rides, even stay the night...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: No matter if you're a man or[n]woman, young or old, coming here[n]has to be supreme stress relief...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I can understand why so many[n]people choose to come now.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Anyway, the amount of things to do[n]is making it hard to decide... How[n]about we go to the amusement park?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well... I think I'd like to[n]go to the amusement park.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Mm-hm, I agree. That's the[n]essential experience of coming[n]here, so it's a great start.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Although, um... I'm actually[n]a little nervous.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Today, well... from other people's[n]perspective, this could be called[n]a... date, could it not?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Never mind. Come on,[n]let's go have some fun.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Wow, I never knew roller[n]coasters were that amazing...![n]My knees are still shaking...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I can't quite put it into words...[n]but I think I understand the[n]appeal of thrill rides now.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I do wonder why anyone thought[n]of making such scary attractions[n]in the first place though...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hm, they gave me this souvenir.[n]I don't really know much about[n]baseball though, to be honest.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Do you like the sport?[n]Here, you can have it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: All this excitement has really[n]tired me out... Let's go home.
